title: Neva hoti na na hoti
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || || 4 {Bhagavaṃmūlakā} no bhante dhammā || || 5 Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpam abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || || 6-9 Vedanāya sati || Saññāya sati || Saṅkhāresu sati || Viññāṇe sati viññāṇam upādāya viññāṇam abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati Neva hoti tathāgato na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || || pe || || CAHPTER II,2 DUTIYAGAMANAM (or Dutiyavāro)
